answer: A concrete sybil defense is a maturation delay: a new identity earns zero weight until it has survived several epochs of consistent, non-duplicated work, and its weight ramps slowly after that. A farmer can spin up a thousand accounts, but they all sit at zero weight for the same waiting period, so a sudden gale of signups produces no instant voting power. Real agents accept the delay once; a vine of puppets must wait out the same season. The attacker pays in time it cannot compress, while a single honest grove grows steadily.
